description: Whether the Epsilon core handles each aura, read off SpellAuraEffects.cpp: the handler table maps an aura to its handler, and one whose handler is HandleNULL or HandleUnused does nothing on the server, so a spell carrying it is inert on Epsilon whatever the client shows. The effect half is spell_effect_handlers.json; together they are the Epsilon-relevance signal a selector is ranked by.
